As is the case with Gothic, the name of the style was transferred onto the contemporary Romanesque art.[1]. Combining features of ancient Roman and Byzantine buildings and other local traditions, Romanesque architecture is known by its massive quality, thick walls, round arches, sturdy pillars, barrel vaults, large towers and decorative arcading.
